explanation: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi provides ₹6,000 per year, not ₹50,000 or ₹10,000. The amount is disbursed in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each, directly into the bank accounts of eligible landholder farmer families via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Beware of fraudulent WhatsApp links or phishing websites.
warning: No government scheme exists providing ₹50,000 or ₹10,000 direct cash transfers to all citizens or farmers. Beware of phishing links that steal your Aadhaar and bank details.
real_facts: The legitimate PM-KISAN scheme provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to eligible landholding farmers via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check status only at pmkisan.gov.in.
citation: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Agriculture, Page 2

sources.quote: With a view to provide income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country, having cultivable land, the Central Government has implemented a Central Sector Scheme, namely, 'Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)'.

explanation: The Central Government is not running any direct nationwide 'Free Laptop 2026' registration link on WhatsApp or Telegram. Such links are fraudulent phishing scams designed to steal personal data. This claim cannot be officially substantiated from CiviQ's approved policy documents.
warning: Central Government is not running any direct nationwide 'Free Laptop 2026' registration link on WhatsApp or Telegram. Such links steal personal data.
real_facts: Legitimate educational assistance is provided via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scholarships through the official National Scholarship Portal at scholarships.gov.in.
citation: PIB Fact Check & Ministry of Electronics & IT Advisory

explanation: No universal ₹8,000/month pension scheme exists. While Atal Pension Yojana exists, the specific citizen pension slabs cannot be substantiated from the operational circular in CiviQ's official document repository. Beware of phishing links collecting Aadhaar numbers.
warning: No scheme provides ₹8,000/month universal pension to all citizens. This is a common WhatsApp fraud used to collect Aadhaar numbers.
real_facts: APY provides a guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000/month at age 60 based on contribution. Apply at your nearest bank branch or Jan Dhan account.

explanation: The Government is not offering 12 free LPG cylinders via WhatsApp registration links. While Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana exists, its official guidelines are not in CiviQ's approved MVP document repository, so this claim cannot be officially verified here. Beware of unverified social media forwards.
warning: Government is not offering 12 free LPG cylinders via WhatsApp registration links. Ujjwala scheme provides subsidised connections — not unlimited free refills.
real_facts: PMUY provides free LPG connections (not unlimited refills) to BPL households. Apply at your nearest LPG distributor or at pmuy.gov.in.
citation: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas Advisory

explanation: While accidental insurance schemes like PMSBY exist, they require bank enrolment and their guidelines are not in CiviQ's approved MVP document repository. This claim cannot be officially verified here. Never register for insurance schemes via WhatsApp links.
warning: While PMSBY does provide ₹2 lakh accidental insurance for just ₹20/year, it is NOT free and cannot be registered via WhatsApp links. Official enrolment is through your bank only.
real_facts: PMSBY provides ₹2 lakh accidental death/disability cover for a premium of ₹20 per year. Auto-debit enrolment via your savings bank account only.
citation: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
